name: shortit
description: ShortIt URL shortener — React frontend and Express API

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,magenta "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix Backend && npm test --prefix frontend
